question: The simplified value of (5)/(16) of (7)/(8)×6+15-10 is:
solution:
**Given**

The mathematical expression to simplify is (5)/(16) of (7)/(8) × 6 + 15 - 10.

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47485e25d1b30c57dc271863db8b99be0c8e209069b2596cc885911d898a8a78.png] 

**Solution:**

5/16 of 7/8 × 6 + 15 - 10

35/128 × 6 + 5

210/128 + 5

105/64 + 5

425/64

**Hence, the simplified value of (5)/(16) of (7)/(8) × 6 + 15 - 10 is 425/64**
